# thinking-corner

> A React component that shows one line of status in a corner of the page: what an AI agent or background job is doing, with a spinner while busy and the elapsed time. MIT. Peer dependency: react >= 18. No other dependencies. Types included.

Install: `npm install thinking-corner`
Or with shadcn: `npx shadcn@latest add https://johnnywon.github.io/thinking_corner/r/thinking-corner.json`

## Exports

- `thinking-corner`: default `ThinkingCorner`; named `ThinkingCornerProvider`, `useCorner`, `useThinkingCorner`, `formatElapsed`, `DEFAULT_TIMING`. The module is marked "use client".
- `thinking-corner/ai-sdk`: `statusFromChat(messages, status, labels?)`, `describePart(part)`, `DEFAULT_LABELS`. Does not import `ai`.

## Vercel AI SDK (useChat)

```jsx
import ThinkingCorner from "thinking-corner";
import { statusFromChat } from "thinking-corner/ai-sdk";
const { messages, status } = useChat();
<ThinkingCorner {...statusFromChat(messages, status)} timer />
```

statusFromChat returns `{ status, busy, tone }`. Lines: "Thinking…", "Calling <tool>…", "<tool> done", "<tool> failed" (tone "error"), "Writing…", "Done.", "Something went wrong." (tone "error").

## Background jobs

```jsx
<ThinkingCornerProvider>{app}</ThinkingCornerProvider>
// in any component below:
const job = useCorner().start("Collecting rows…");
job.update("Writing CSV…");
job.done("Export ready."); // or job.fail("Export failed.")
```

Always end a job with done() or fail(), or the spinner keeps running. Several jobs can run at once; the corner shows "[n]" and the latest running job.

## Controlled props

`status`, `busy`, `tone` ("default" | "error"), `timer`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`, `prefix`, `position` ("bottom-right" | "bottom-left" | "top-right" | "top-left"), `theme` ("dark" | "light"), `maxWidth`, `timing`, `onClick`, `actionLabel`. Source mode: `source` (URL or async function), `interval`.
